newsitem.title: CHILE: Port conditions update - Chile - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Chile - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

CHILE, March 7 - La Paz - Heavy rainfall has caused landslides which have interrupted traffic to and from the port of Arica. Other damage and the collapse of a bridge has been reported. It was understood that about 400 truckers are stranded on the Arica-Tambo Quamado-Patacamaya highway. Alternative roads are also in a bad condition on account of the rains.
